name: Frame Window Counter
description: Record a macro, then measure how many ticks (frames) each click can be moved early or late before you die. Experimental.

range.name: Test range (± ticks)
range.description: Each click is shifted from -range to +range ticks. Bigger is slower.

after.name: Survive after next click (ticks)
after.description: How long a shifted run must survive past the next click to count as a pass.
